scope: All 393 publications present in the official website catalog. Later alumni publications outside this catalog are not automatically imported.
method: Individual exact-title searches with award, nomination, finalist, honourable, honorable and prize keywords; cross-check positive matches against conference lists, university reports, and original author/lab records.
limitations: No-confirmed-record means no reliable award record was established in this review, not proof that the paper has never received recognition.
Search indexes can conflate an award heading with another paper on the same page. Search snippets alone are not treated as exact-title prize evidence.
Google Scholar and several ACM/conference/profile pages block automated reads. Indexed original author statements are identified as such.
RelicVR and VirusBoxing are cross-matched from coauthor competition honors and the corresponding competition entries; Myopic Bike has an explicit exact-title finalist label.
